rec.name: Collection Page Price Hide Toggle (CRO | Prices)

what.text: A theme-level on/off switch that hides all price information on collection pages and on featured-collection blocks. With it off, prices show as normal (Variant #2). With it on, product cards show only image, title and optional badge/teaser, with no price (Variant #1). It is set up as a checkbox in the theme settings and not as a standalone section, although the ticket calls it a Section named 'CRO | Prices'. In the editor it sits under Collection → Collection page → Theme Settings → 'Price Hide Button'.

why.text: Without a price on the grid, shoppers can't screen products out on price alone, so they click through to the PDP. There, the benefits, reviews and trust elements get a chance to justify the price before it is judged. This raises PDP views and works well for high-consideration or premium products. It also works as a clean A/B test: price visible vs. hidden on the listing. The effect can go either way, because some shoppers dislike hidden prices, so it should be tested rather than assumed.

how.text: 1) In config/settings_schema.json add a 'Collections' group with a checkbox `show_price_on_collections` (default false; label: 'The activation hides all price information on featured collections and collection pages'). 2) In snippets/product-item.liquid, after the closing </product-item> tag, add `{% if settings.show_price_on_collections == true %}<style>.shopify-section--featured-collections .product-item-meta__price-list-container, .shopify-section--main-collection .product-item-meta__price-list-container {display:none;}</style>{% endif %}`. 3) Merchants turn the checkbox on or off in the theme customizer. The 'show' variable name is misleading, because true means prices are hidden. For an A/B test, run the two states as separate theme/variant versions or via the test tool. The ticket says non-devs cannot install it, so a developer has to do it.

items: Hide prices on collection pages and featured collections (checkbox `show_price_on_collections`, default off, true = prices hidden)
Show product teaser on collection page (checkbox, default off; uses the 'Product Teaser' metafield)

dependencies.text: Needs a theme with a `product-item` snippet and the CSS classes `.product-item-meta__price-list-container`, `.shopify-section--main-collection` and `.shopify-section--featured-collections`. The code appears to target a Maestrooo-style theme such as Prestige or Impact (inference). The core price hiding needs no metafield. The optional teaser needs the product metafield 'Product Teaser' to be filled in. The teaser and badge settings were added because of the 'Spotlight' feature (per a dev comment) and are not needed for price hiding. Developer installation is required. The price is hidden only via CSS (display:none), so it is still present in the page source.

items: Collection page bounce and exit rate
